rows.function: Dedicated boot strap: low = flash boot, high = serial boot

rows.reset_and_rom_state: ROM USART1 pin: may be set to AF7 with a pull-up in any boot that reaches serial boot, including a failed flash boot.
rows.note: To the probe's receive pad. A ROM UART pin, which is acceptable for a UART and gives a serial-boot route through the probe.
rows.source: DS14791 Table 18 p.99, Table 19 p.117; UM3234 Table 29 p.29; MB1940 sheet 3

rows.reset_and_rom_state: ROM USART1 pin: may be set to AF7 with a pull-up in any boot that reaches serial boot, including a failed flash boot.

rows.function: Dedicated output, high in Run, low in Standby
rows.reset_and_rom_state: Hardware raises it once VDD and VDDA18AON pass power-on reset, before any code runs.

rows.reset_and_rom_state: Analog input in reset and through every ROM boot mode; the gate pull-down holds the FET off until firmware drives it.
rows.note: N-FET gate (SI2312CDS). Gate pull-down 10 to 22 kilohm, not 100: pin leakage of up to 5 microamps across 100 kilohm would reach the FET's 0.45 V minimum threshold. Any reset returns the pin to analog, so HOLD drops for the whole boot.
rows.source: DS14791 Table 18 p.98, Table 17 p.88, Tables 19 and 20 p.116 and 127; UM3234 section 3.12.3 p.27-30

supply_pins:
1V8_MAIN (always on): VDD (G13, H12, H13, J12, J13, K13), VDDA18AON (F6), VDDA18PLL (M5), VBAT (E1), VDDIO3 (N13, P13), VDDIO2 (L13, L14, M14, M15), VDDIO4 (E8, F8), and PDR_ON (A1), which "must always be connected to VDDA18AON" (AN5967 Table 7 p.14).
1V8_AUX (switched by PWR_ON): VDDSMPS (K1 to K6), VDDA18PMU (G1, through a ferrite), VDDA18ADC (N6), VREF+ (U2, also the dials' top end), VDDA18CSI (R5).
Core: VLXSMPS (J1 to J6) through 1 µH to VDDCORE (L6, L12, M7, M9, M11, N8, N10, N12, P11); VFBSMPS (G2) senses VDDCORE; VDDCSI (R4) to VDDCORE; V08CAP (F1) gets 4.7 µF only.
3V3_SW: VDDIO5 (E9, F9), with the card.
USB unused: VDD33USB (A4) and VDDA18USB (C5) to VSS. AN5967 Table 5 p.7 says "Connected to VSS if not used", with note 2 p.8: "If USB/UCPD features are not used : DP/DM pins must be connected to VSS. TXRTUNE pins must be left floating/open. UCPD_CC1/CC2 pins must be left floating/open." Figure 6 p.12 draws both supplies grounded.
Ground: VREF- (T2), VSSA (M6), VSSAON (G6), VSSAPMU (F2), VSSSMPS (H1 to H6), VSS.
Decoupling follows AN5967 Table 6 p.12-13. Balls are from DS14791 Table 18 p.108-111 and match MB1940 sheet 4.
